main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads N, A, B, and p, then uses interval DP over p to maintain minimum/second-minimum and maximum/second-maximum values and to find the minimum left/right extension cost, finally printing dpc[0][N-1]." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the next integer token from the Scanner input into N. RESULT N]
            [COMMAND Read the next long token from the Scanner input into A. RESULT A]
            [COMMAND Read the next long token from the Scanner input into B. RESULT B]
            [COMMAND Allocate int array p of length N. RESULT p]
            [COMMAND For each index i from 0 to N-1 inclusive, read the next integer token from the Scanner input and assign it to p[i]. RESULT p_filled]
            [COMMAND Allocate five N by N DP tables: long[][] dpc, int[][] dpmin, int[][] dpmin2, int[][] dpmax, and int[][] dpmax2. All elements default to zero. RESULT dp_tables]
            [COMMAND For each index i from 0 to N-1 inclusive, initialize the diagonal cells: dpc[i][i] = 0, dpmin[i][i] = p[i], dpmax[i][i] = p[i], dpmin2[i][i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE, and dpmax2[i][i] = -1. RESULT diagonal_initialized]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over interval length d from 1 to N-1 inclusive and the inner loop over start i from 0 to N-d-1 inclusive, update dpmin[i][i+d] and dpmin2[i][i+d] for interval [i, i+d] by comparing p[i+d] with dpmin[i][i+d-1] and dpmin2[i][i+d-1]: if p[i+d] is smaller than the old minimum, the old minimum becomes the second minimum and p[i+d] becomes the minimum; otherwise if p[i+d] is smaller than the old second minimum, p[i+d] becomes the second minimum and the old minimum is kept; otherwise both old minimum and second minimum are kept. RESULT dpmin_updated]
            [COMMAND Within the same loops over d and i for interval [i, i+d], update dpmax[i][i+d] and dpmax2[i][i+d] symmetrically using p[i+d] against dpmax[i][i+d-1] and dpmax2[i][i+d-1]: if p[i+d] is larger than the old maximum, the old maximum becomes the second maximum and p[i+d] becomes the maximum; otherwise if p[i+d] is larger than the old second maximum, p[i+d] becomes the second maximum and the old maximum is kept; otherwise both old maximum and second maximum are kept. RESULT dpmax_updated]
            [COMMAND Within the same loops over d and i, declare long rightcost and compute it by appending p[i+d] to interval [i, i+d-1]: if p[i+d] > dpmax[i][i+d-1], then rightcost = dpc[i][i+d-1]; else if p[i+d] > dpmax2[i][i+d-1], then rightcost = dpc[i][i+d-1] + Math.min(A, B); else rightcost = dpc[i][i+d-1] + B. RESULT rightcost]
            [COMMAND Within the same loops over d and i, declare long leftcost and compute it by prepending p[i] to interval [i+1, i+d]: if p[i] < dpmin[i+1][i+d], then leftcost = dpc[i+1][i+d]; else if p[i] < dpmin2[i+1][i+d], then leftcost = dpc[i+1][i+d] + Math.min(A, B); else leftcost = dpc[i+1][i+d] + A. RESULT leftcost]
            [COMMAND Within the same loops over d and i, set dpc[i][i+d] = Math.min(leftcost, rightcost). RESULT dpc_interval_computed]
            [COMMAND Within the same loops over d and i, call debug(i, i+d, leftcost, rightcost, dpmin[i][i+d], dpmin2[i][i+d], dpmax[i][i+d], dpmax2[i][i+d]); this call observes values and does not change DP state. RESULT debug_interval]
            [COMMAND After all DP loops complete, print dpc[0][N-1] to stdout using System.out.println. RESULT printed_answer]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: N is negative when int[] p = new int[N] is executed.]
        [LOG "Array allocation with a negative length is impossible."]
        [THROW NegativeArraySizeException "Thrown because new int[N] requires N to be non-negative."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: N is 0 when System.out.println(dpc[0][N-1]) is reached.]
        [LOG "The final DP access uses dpc[0][-1] on an empty DP table."]
        [THROW ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException "Thrown because dpc has no row 0 and the resolved column -1 is invalid."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
